stack.why: pnpm strict isolation prevents accidental cross-package dep leakage; turbo caches build/test/lint tasks by dependency graph, saving 40-60s per iteration for a solo dev. pnpm-workspace.yaml covers packages/* and apps/*.

Algorand-Foundation-standard toolchain. puyapy 5.8.1 outputs ARC-56 JSON by default; algokit generate client produces typed TS clients consumed by the rest of the stack. Never write 'Puya v5.0' in technical docs — pip packages are algorand-python + puyapy with separate version numbers. AlgoKit 3.x does not exist.

stack.tech: algosdk + algokit-utils + generated ARC-56 TS clients
stack.why: algosdk 3.5.2 is required peer dep of both algokit-utils 9.2.0 and @perawallet/connect 1.5.2. Generated clients from algokit-client-generator@6.0.1 are the only interface between TS code and contracts — no raw algosdk group construction in apps.

Replaces 500+ lines of hand-rolled WC v2 session management from metafarm-frontend. Handles Pera (native SDK, not raw WC v2), Defly, Lute, Kibisis, Exodus behind a single useWallet() hook. Requires algosdk ^3.x — compatible with 3.5.2.

NestJS is correct for Boost (complex domain, multi-module, team). Fairground has 3 HTTP routes per game + 1 WS namespace — NestJS adds 30-40 boilerplate files. Hono's Web Standard API enables future Cloudflare Worker deployment for the proof-card CDN endpoint. Fastify loses that portability.

Game dApp needs RSC for leaderboard/history pages (no client bundle) + client components for game canvas + WS integration. Astro for the static landing (zero JS for non-interactive sections, rsync deploys in 3s). Both use Tailwind 4.3.0 + React 19.

Three tables per game (bets, sessions, leaderboard) + shared treasury/jackpot. Drizzle generates pure SQL, no binary generation step, cleaner Docker build than Prisma. Keeper batch UPDATE WHERE round < N is expressible verbatim. Re-evaluate Prisma if team grows past 3 devs.

SSE is unidirectional — cashout signals require bidirectional messaging. Keeper publishes to Redis pub/sub channel; Hono WS handler subscribes and fans out to connected clients. Decouples keeper from API process — keeper crashes don't drop WS connections.

stack.tech: tsx polling process + Redis SETNX leader election
stack.why: VRF resolution is not a retryable job (BullMQ semantics are wrong). Each resolution is a unique on-chain event. Two keeper containers with restart: always and Redis SETNX lock (10s TTL, refreshed every 4s) — standby promotes automatically if primary crashes. 48h player-triggered refund backdoor in contract means keeper failure never locks funds.

Ported from beef-web satori pipeline (the highest-craft card generator in the ecosystem). Generates shareable VRF result PNGs without Python/Pillow dependency on Cometa VPS — self-contained Node package. Redis caches proof:{txnId} permanently (proofs are immutable).

Consistent with cometa-farm-landing and prediction-market/landing. OKLCH design tokens in @theme block. Amber-gold primary (oklch(0.78 0.18 65)) — distinct from Cometa green, beef-web red, prediction-market orange-red.

Native ESM, no ts-jest transform config. vitest.workspace.ts at root covers all packages. 3-5x faster cold starts vs Jest+ts-jest. Boost's ts-jest patterns don't transfer cleanly. Contract integration tests hit AlgoKit LocalNet (Docker); unit tests mock algosdk client.

Ported verbatim from Boost. plugin:@typescript-eslint/recommended-requiring-type-checking enables type-aware linting. no-floating-promises=error and no-explicit-any=error block the most common async bugs in keeper bot code.

Free, zero oracle fee. Commit-reveal: bet commits to round N+8 (~22s wait), resolve() reads beacon output synchronously via inner app call after that round passes. Simpler than Gora (no async request-response). 48h player-triggered refund backdoor required in all game contracts.

stack.version: Separate stack from Cometa (~/fairground/docker-compose.yml), Nginx reverse proxy
stack.why: Mirrors the proven Cometa deploy pattern. Separate compose stack prevents Fairground container crashes from affecting Cometa. Landing deploys as static files via rsync. Kubernetes re-evaluation when any single service needs horizontal scaling.
TypeScript 6.0.3 is the latest stable as of 2026-05-30. tsup bundles packages/* for consumption by apps. TS project references across packages for type safety without bundling during development.

monorepoTree.purpose: Monorepo root — pnpm-workspace.yaml, turbo.json, tsconfig.base.json, .eslintrc.js, .prettierrc, .gitignore, CLAUDE.md, BOARD.md, AGENTS.md

Python-only AlgoKit workspace (NOT a pnpm package). .algokit.toml, pyproject.toml, virtualenv. smart_contracts/: coinflip/, house_treasury/, leaderboard/ (Puya source). artifacts/: *.arc56.json (puyapy output). tests/: algorand-python-testing suite.

HouseTreasury Puya contract — FIRST contract to build before any game contract. Global pool, game registry, max_payout_bps (default 100 = 1% of live balance), emergency_pause. All game contracts call get_available_balance() via foreign app ref.

CometaFlip v1 Puya contract (~150-200 lines). flip(salt_hash, referrer), resolve(player), refund(). Box storage per player: key=address (32B), value=round+bet+salt+claimed (49B) = 35,000 microALGO MBR. Jackpot hook parameter present (rate can be zero). Referral 0.5% rake baked in.
Leaderboard Puya stub contract. Records wins/losses/volume per wallet across all games. Game contracts call it via inner app call on every resolution.
ARC-56 application.json files output by puyapy. Auto-generated — never edit by hand. Fed into algokit generate client to populate packages/sdk/src/clients/.

@fairground/sdk — IS a pnpm package. src/clients/: typed TS clients generated by algokit-client-generator@6.0.1 from artifacts/. src/vrf/beacon.ts: MAINNET_BEACON_APP_ID=947957720n, targetBeaconRound(), verifyFlipResult(), waitForBeaconRound(). src/index.ts: re-exports all clients and VRF helpers.

@fairground/types — shared Zod 4.4.3 schemas and TypeScript types. BetOutcome, GameId, SessionState, LeaderboardEntry. All microAlgo amounts typed as bigint. ApiResponse shapes. Imported by apps/game, packages/api, packages/keeper.

@fairground/proof-card — satori + @resvg/resvg-js + sharp PNG generator. Ported from beef-web/src/cards/. Templates: VrfResultCard (1600x900 landscape, 1200x1200 square). theme.ts: Fairground amber palette for satori (no CSS vars). CLI: npx tsx src/cli.ts. Cached in Redis proof:{txnId} permanently.

@fairground/price-client — Vestige price batching queue extracted verbatim from cometa/metafarm-frontend/src/providers/coinPriceProvider.ts. 250ms debounce, 25-asset chunks, circuit breaker (5 failures → 30s cooldown). swap axios for fetch. Used for ALGO/USD display in game UI and treasury balance conversion.

@fairground/api — Hono 4.12.23 + @hono/node-server 2.0.4. Routes: POST /games/:gameId/bets, GET /games/:gameId/state/:sessionId, GET /leaderboard, GET /proof/:txnId, WS upgrade at /ws. Zod validation via @hono/zod-validator. pino logging. prom-client /metrics. geo-block middleware (required before any Foundation RT).

@fairground/db — Drizzle 0.45.2 schema + pg 8.21.0 client. Tables: bets (id, wallet_address, game_id, amount_microalgo bigint, vrf_round bigint, vrf_output, outcome, resolved_at, txn_id, referrer_wallet, referral_rake_bps, proof_card_url), sessions (multi-step games), jackpot, leaderboard_snapshots. Migrations run by keeper on startup.

@fairground/keeper — tsx 4.22.3 polling process. 4-second loop. Redis SETNX keeperlock (10s TTL, refreshed every 4s). Queries Postgres for expired VRF sessions; calls contract resolve() via @fairground/sdk client; updates resolved_at; publishes to Redis pub/sub. Two instances in Docker Compose (primary + standby).

Next.js 16.2.6 App Router game dApp. RSC for leaderboard and history pages. Client components for game canvas (coinflip animation, VRF round countdown, proof card modal). @txnlab/use-wallet-react@4.6.0 wallet integration. Tailwind 4.3.0 dark amber palette.

Astro 6.4.2 + Tailwind 4.3.0 + React 19 islands static landing. Copied from cometa-farm-landing pattern. BaseLayout.astro: cursor ember trail (amber hue 55-70), grain overlay, scroll-reveal IO, JSON-LD, Plausible. Sections: Hero, VRF explainer, Games, Proof-of-fairness live stats, Leaderboard preview, FAQ, terminal easter egg.

algorand-degen-games-2026-05.md (design bible — copied from cometa-strategy) and algorand-build-ideas-2026-05.md (ecosystem context — copied from cometa-strategy). Source of truth for all product decisions. Every architectural decision is traceable to these docs.
geo-blocking.md (Cloudflare Workers geo-block spec: US, UK, TH, ID, IN, BR — required before any public announcement or Foundation RT), weekly-plan.md, safety-state.md.

Project-level Claude Code config. settings.json (mainnet-deploy guard hook, contract-test-gate hook, ALGORAND_NETWORK=localnet default env var). skills/: fairground-contract/, fairground-frontend/, smart-contract-audit/, puya-gotchas/.

Project MCP servers: algorand MCP (ALGORAND_NETWORK=mainnet, switch to localnet during contract dev), vestige MCP (optional, not on public npm — fallback to WebFetch vestigelabs.org), playwright MCP (visual QA + Alpha Arcade monitoring). context7 inherited from global ~/.claude/mcp.json.

Separate stack from Cometa at ~/cometa/docker-compose.yml. Services: fairground-api (port 3010), fairground-keeper-primary, fairground-keeper-standby, fairground-db (postgres:16-alpine, not exposed), fairground-redis (redis:7-alpine, not exposed). Nginx on host routes api.fairground.xyz → 3010.

packages.name: @fairground/contracts
packages.summary: Python-only AlgoKit workspace. Puya contracts for house_treasury (first, required before any game), coinflip (v1, ~150-200 lines), leaderboard (stub). puyapy 5.8.1 compiles to ARC-56 artifacts/. Not a pnpm package — AlgoKit manages it independently via .algokit.toml.

packages.name: @fairground/sdk
packages.summary: Bridge between Puya contracts and TS apps. src/clients/: typed TS clients auto-generated by algokit-client-generator@6.0.1 from artifacts/*.arc56.json. src/vrf/beacon.ts: MAINNET_BEACON_APP_ID=947957720n, targetBeaconRound(currentRound, delay=8n), verifyFlipResult(), waitForBeaconRound(). Never edit generated files by hand — regenerate via algokit generate client.

packages.name: @fairground/types
packages.summary: Shared Zod 4.4.3 schemas and TypeScript types. BetOutcome, GameId enum (coinflip, minefield), SessionState, LeaderboardEntry. BigInt rule enforced: all microAlgo amounts, ASA amounts, app IDs, round numbers are bigint. API response serializes bigint as string. Zod env schema for packages/api and packages/keeper.

packages.name: @fairground/db
packages.summary: Drizzle ORM schema + pg client. Three core tables from day one: bets (id, wallet_address, game_id, amount_microalgo bigint, vrf_round bigint, vrf_output, outcome, txn_id, referrer_wallet, referral_rake_bps, proof_card_url), sessions (multi-step game state), jackpot (balance + last trigger). Migrations run by keeper on startup. Shared by api and keeper.

packages.name: @fairground/api
packages.summary: Hono REST API + WebSocket server. Routes: POST /games/:gameId/bets, GET /games/:gameId/state/:sessionId, GET /leaderboard (Redis ZREVRANGE), GET /proof/:txnId (generates PNG via @fairground/proof-card, caches in Redis permanently). WS at /ws for multiplier ticks and game events. Geo-block middleware for US/UK/TH/ID/IN/BR required before public launch. pino logging. prom-client /metrics. Env validated with Zod at startup.

packages.name: @fairground/keeper
packages.summary: VRF session resolver and jackpot trigger. tsx 4.22.3 polling process, 4-second loop. Redis SETNX keeperlock (10s TTL). Queries Postgres for sessions where vrf_round <= current_round AND resolved_at IS NULL. Calls algod to confirm round exists, then calls contract resolve() via @fairground/sdk typed client. Updates resolved_at, publishes game events to Redis pub/sub. Two Docker Compose instances (primary + standby).

packages.name: @fairground/proof-card
packages.summary: VRF result PNG generator. Ported from beef-web/src/cards/. satori JSX-to-SVG, @resvg/resvg-js PNG, sharp compositing + border frame. Templates: VrfResultCard (1600x900 for Twitter, 1200x1200 for Instagram). theme.ts: hardcoded amber palette for satori (no CSS vars). outcomeColor('heads'|'tails'|'jackpot'), vrfProofColor(). CLI: npx tsx src/cli.ts.

packages.name: @fairground/price-client
packages.summary: Vestige price batching queue + circuit breaker. Extracted verbatim from cometa/metafarm-frontend/src/providers/coinPriceProvider.ts. 250ms debounce, 25-asset chunks grouped by denominatingAssetId. Circuit breaker: 5 consecutive failures → 30s cooldown, partial reset on timeout. fetch replaces axios. Used for ALGO/USD display in game UI and treasury balance monitoring.

packages.name: apps/game
packages.summary: Next.js 16.2.6 App Router game dApp. RSC for leaderboard and bet history pages. Client components for game canvas (coin flip animation, VRF round countdown timer ~22s, proof card share modal). @txnlab/use-wallet-react@4.6.0 wallet integration. All bet txn group construction delegated to @fairground/sdk typed clients — no raw algosdk in this package. Tailwind 4.3.0 dark amber palette.

conventions.lint: ESLint 8.x with plugin:@typescript-eslint/recommended-requiring-type-checking (type-aware). Rules: no-floating-promises=error, require-await=error, no-explicit-any=error, no-unused-vars=error (argsIgnorePattern ^_). Ported verbatim from boost-api/.eslintrc.js. Remove emitDecoratorMetadata and experimentalDecorators from tsconfig (NestJS-specific, not needed here).
conventions.format: Prettier 3.x — singleQuote: true, trailingComma: 'all', tabWidth: 2, semi: true, printWidth: 100, bracketSpacing: true, arrowParens: 'always', endOfLine: 'lf'. Ported verbatim from boost-api/.prettierrc. Husky 9.x + lint-staged 16.x runs eslint --fix && prettier --write on staged *.ts/*.tsx files before every commit.
conventions.test: Vitest 4.1.7 everywhere. vitest.workspace.ts at root covers all packages. IVrfBeacon interface with LocalNet stub for deterministic contract tests. Kill-the-mutant check required: comment out a key line in the SUT and confirm at least one test fails before committing. For every mockResolvedValue add a mockRejectedValue sibling. it.each for parameterized bet amounts. Baseline test count tracked in CLAUDE.md; never commit if count decreases. Contract integration tests hit AlgoKit LocalNet Docker.
conventions.commit: Lowercase verb, no type prefix. Format: '<verb> <what>'. Examples: 'add coinflip contract v1', 'fix max-bet enforcement in house treasury', 'implement proof card PNG generator'. No feat:/fix:/chore: prefixes. No internal jargon (no 'Phase 1', 'FG-007'). No co-authorship lines. No --no-verify. Update BOARD.md task status in same commit. Push after committing.
conventions.naming: @fairground/* npm scope for all packages. Task IDs: FG-NNN. Package directories: packages/sdk, packages/db, packages/api, packages/keeper, packages/proof-card, packages/price-client, packages/types, packages/contracts. App directories: apps/game, apps/landing. All microAlgo amounts, ASA amounts, app IDs, round numbers are bigint in TS — never Number. API responses serialize bigint as string via JSON replacer.
conventions.tsconfig: Extends tsconfig.base.json at repo root. Options from boost-api: strict, strictNullChecks, noImplicitAny, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, noImplicitReturns, noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters, forceConsistentCasingInFileNames, target ES2021, resolveJsonModule, esModuleInterop. Remove emitDecoratorMetadata + experimentalDecorators. Add paths for @fairground/* workspace packages. Each package has its own tsconfig.json extending root base.

skillsToPort.reason: Multi-expert audit framework (methodology, finding-format.md, triager.md, report-template.md, severity calibration) is chain-agnostic. Port wholesale. Keep existing solidity-checks.md, anchor-checks.md etc for cross-chain pattern recognition.
skillsToPort.adapt: Add puya-checks.md covering AVM-specific risk surface: (1) solvency invariant — max payout enforced from live treasury balance at resolve time, not at bet time; (2) box storage limits — max 2500 bytes/box, 8 box references per txn; (3) inner txn limits — max 256 per group; (4) VRF commit-reveal timing — minimum N+8 rounds, refund backdoor if beacon delayed 48h+; (5) idempotency key — beaconRound+walletAddress+sessionNonce prevents double-payout on retry; (6) referral wallet opt-in verification before inner transfer fires; (7) box deletion only after claimed flag is set — never before.

skillsToPort.reason: as-gotchas format (named pitfalls with before/after code) prevents an entire class of Puya-specific runtime failures that an AI agent will hit without explicit guidance. Same structure, Puya content.
skillsToPort.adapt: Replace all AssemblyScript content with Puya gotchas: (1) box must be pre-funded before access — 2500 + 400*(key_len+val_len) microALGO MBR or txn fails with 'invalid box reference'; (2) inner transactions are atomic and immediate — no pending state; (3) never delete box before claimed flag is set; (4) box size max 2500 bytes, 8 box refs per app call; (5) ARC-56 generated clients in packages/sdk/src/clients/ are auto-generated — never edit, always regenerate; (6) always use simulate() before send() on non-trivial production paths; (7) GlobalMap/BoxMap require algorand-python >=3.0.0 — pin exact version; (8) commit round must be N+8 minimum — N+4 can arrive before the user's txn confirms under congestion.

skillsToPort.reason: verdict-landing skill structure (SKILL.md + reference/ subdirectory) is the cleanest local skill pattern in the ecosystem. Reuse the structure, replace all content with Fairground contract-specific reference material.
skillsToPort.adapt: New content: 'When to invoke' = before writing any Puya contract code. Reference files: reference/avm-constraints.md (box MBR formula, group size 16, inner txn 256, box refs 8/call, 1KB per ref), reference/vrf-integration.md (beacon app 947957720 mainnet, commit N+8, resolve permissionless, 48h refund backdoor, deterministic cell expansion for Minefield), reference/house-pool-math.md (2000 ALGO seed, 0.5 ALGO max bet, 2% edge, max_payout=1% live balance enforced at resolve time), reference/compliance-ops.md (geo-block jurisdictions: US UK TH ID IN BR, frame as VRF demonstration for Foundation grants, never mention real-money gambling in grant applications). Workflow: load references, run puya-gotchas check, write contract, run tests, kill-the-mutant check, commit.

envVars.note: development | production | test. Validated with Zod enum at startup.
API HTTP port. Default 3010. Coerce to number via Zod.
Redis connection string. Required. Pattern: redis://fairground-redis:6379.
Algorand node URL. Required. Default: https://mainnet-api.algonode.cloud for mainnet. Use https://localhost:4001 for LocalNet.
Algorand node API token. Empty string for public AlgoNode endpoints.
Algorand indexer URL. Required. Default: https://mainnet-idx.algonode.cloud.

localnet | testnet | mainnet. Default localnet in .claude/settings.json env — forces explicit override for mainnet operations during development. Prevents accidental mainnet queries during contract test iterations.
Deployed HouseTreasury contract app ID. bigint via Zod coerce. Required before accepting any bets. Mainnet: set after first deploy.
Deployed CoinflipContract app ID. bigint via Zod coerce. Required for coinflip game routes.
Algorand VRF beacon app ID. bigint. Mainnet: 947957720. Testnet: verify before use. Defined in @fairground/sdk/src/vrf/beacon.ts as MAINNET_BEACON_APP_ID constant — env var overrides for testnet.

25-word mnemonic for house pool seeder wallet. Required for keeper. Never commit to git — block-secret-commit.sh hook guards against staging. Minimum balance: 2000 ALGO before any public announcement; 5000-10000 ALGO before Foundation amplification.
Minimum bet in microALGO. bigint. Default 500000 (0.5 ALGO). Zod coerce.bigint().default(500000n).

Absolute maximum bet cap in microALGO. bigint. Default 500000 (0.5 ALGO for coinflip v1). Contract also enforces max_payout <= 1% of live treasury balance at resolve time — this env var is an additional frontend-side soft cap.
Auto-pause threshold. bigint. Default 2000000000 (2000 ALGO). Keeper monitors treasury; if live balance drops below this threshold, emits PAUSE event. Contract enforces its own pause independently.
Comma-separated allowed origins. Default: https://fairground.xyz,https://app.fairground.xyz,http://localhost:3000. Transform via splitCommas in Zod.
primary | standby. Used as the Redis SETNX lock value so the primary can identify itself. Set per Docker Compose service.
Domain string for Plausible analytics script in the landing BaseLayout.astro. Example: fairground.xyz.
WalletConnect Cloud project ID required by use-wallet for WC v2 sessions. Register at cloud.walletconnect.com. Injected into apps/game at build time via NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix.

openQuestions: algokit-client-generator@6.0.1 describes itself as 'ARC-0032' in the npm description but should accept ARC-56 input from puyapy 5.8.1. Verify by compiling one contract, running algokit generate client, and checking the generated output shape before committing to the ARC-56-only pipeline. Fallback: use --output-arc32 flag in puyapy if client-generator rejects ARC-56.

TESTNET_BEACON_APP_ID: the research cites 110096026 but this must be verified via algorand MCP (api_algod_get_application_by_id) before any testnet integration tests are written. Never hardcode without verification.

@goplausible/vestige-mcp is not on public npm. Verify it loads via 'npx -y @goplausible/vestige-mcp' on first project setup before relying on it in any workflow. If it fails, switch all price queries to WebFetch against api.vestigelabs.org directly.

Geo-blocking implementation choice: Cloudflare Workers (preferred — CDN layer, can't be bypassed by changing Accept-Language) vs IP detection middleware in packages/api (simpler but bypassable). Decision must be made before any public announcement. Thai IP block is non-negotiable (Nikita's legal exposure in Bangkok).

HouseTreasury contract architecture: does coinflip v1 hold its own ALGO balance in the game contract itself (simpler) or does it call into a separate HouseTreasury contract for every bet/resolve (correct long-term)? The research is categorical that the unified treasury must exist before game 2, but coinflip v1 could proxy through a thin treasury facade even if the full cross-game allocation logic ships in v1.1. Decide before writing the first line of Puya.

Domain name: fairground.xyz vs fairground.app vs fairground.bet. The .bet TLD is most semantically correct but may signal gambling to payment processors and app stores. .xyz is neutral. Decide before purchasing domain and setting up Nginx/Cloudflare.

WalletConnect Project ID: must be registered at cloud.walletconnect.com before any wallet integration testing. This is a free registration but the project ID is required at build time (NEXT_PUBLIC_WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID env var).

Proof card endpoint domain: the Hono API at api.fairground.xyz/proof/:txnId generates and serves the PNG. For Twitter card previews to work, the URL in the Twitter intent must be publicly accessible before the tweet is sent. This means the API must be deployed to mainnet before the first game is public — not after.
